QuestInfo.name: [Advice from General Maestro] Trusting Trust
QuestInfo.0: You'll need faith in your comrades to pass the M-Forcer Action Exam! Talk to General Maestro for advice on how to get more faith.
QuestInfo.1: General Maestro's advice on how to get more faith? Eliminate monsters! He says to hunt monsters #bbetween 11 levels below you and 21 levels above you.#k
QuestInfo.2: You're received Trusting Trust from General Mastro!

0.0: You here for the M-Forcer Action Exam? Perfect timing, I was just looking for someone to-- Zzzzzzzz. *snort* What?! Right. You'll need three things to become an M-Forcer: courage, will, and faith! And you'll need them in abundance!
0.1: In fact, all you have to do is-- Zzzzzzz. *snort* What?! Right. You need #bcourage, will, and faith,#k and tons of it! But you can't do it alone. You have to lean on your allies, and that's where Trusting Trust comes into play.

yes.0: Defeat monsters to prove your faith! Remember, #bonly monsters that are between 11 levels below you and 21 levels above you count!#k Now get out there and kick some as-- Zzzzzz.

no.0: Have you no trust in me, young aspiring M-Forcer?

1.0: Once, even M-Forcers lacked faith in their comrades. Everyone wanted to be a lone wolf. But when I fell asleep behind enemy lines, we realized how foolish that mentality was.

yes.0: Those who have faith in their comrades will grow stronger and stronger. I hope you've learned that important lesson about Trusting Trust!

mob.0: Defeat monsters to prove your faith! Remember, #bonly monsters that are between 11 levels below you and 21 levels above you count!#k Now get out there and kick some as-- Zzzzzz.
